explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain why the optimal objective increases from 9800 to 10450 by tracing the exact code additions that implement the business-owner’s “rush orders” interpretation. Your answer must name the revised decision variables and constraints that did not exist in the original model, map them to the exact `general_parameters.csv` field names and the business brief terms in backticks, and quantify the 650 improvement using the actual produced rush quantities and per-unit bonus logic. Then use the revised LP-relaxation diagnostics to identify which constraints are binding (`Warehouse_Space`, `Rush_Items_Cap`, `Min_Tables_Total`) with their slack and dual values, interpret the business meaning of those shadow prices, and explain why you cannot reliably extrapolate profit linearly from the duals for a large increase in rush capacity.
